hints.title: Candy Quota Cap Limit
hints.text: The sister can eat at most n divided by two candies. What is the maximum number of distinct candy types she can receive under this quota?

hints.title: Minimum Of Types And Allowance Invariant
hints.text: If unique candy types exceed n divided by two, she can choose one of each up to her allowance. If unique types are fewer, she takes all unique types.

hints.title: Set Deduplication Evaluation Procedure
hints.text: Convert the candy type list to a unique collection. Return the minimum between the size of this unique collection and total candies divided by two.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting takes O(N log N) time, while combinations testing takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Inserting into a hash set takes O(N) time and requires O(N) auxiliary space, finding the answer in one step.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that the answer is always min(unique_types, n / 2) and articulate why.
